snippet.title: False Hero - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
False Hero will release on October 1, 2026!

I'm really happy to announce that False Hero will release very soon! On October 1st you will be able to explore the lands of the gods and finally face Death.

You can wishlist it on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2538870/False_Hero/
Join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/yHUdDcYJZ6

I'm making good progress adding all the final content I have planned. All armor pieces and Combat Scrolls are now implemented and the new NPCs are only missing Voice Acting.

Until release, I will add a few more secrets to the world, update the visuals of some older areas and spend a lot of time testing and balancing to make this game as close to my vision as possible.
I can't wait for you all to be able to play it!
